========================================================================
Algorithm: Fake ESKF (test.algorithm.fake_eskf)
Source: Recomputed
State vector order and physical units:
  0: δpE [m]
  1: δpN [m]
  2: δpU [m]
  3: δvE [m/s]
  4: δvN [m/s]
  5: δvU [m/s]
  6: δθX [rad]
  7: δθY [rad]
  8: δθZ [rad]
  9: δbgX [rad/s]
  10: δbgY [rad/s]
  11: δbgZ [rad/s]
  12: δbaX [m/s²]
  13: δbaY [m/s²]
  14: δbaZ [m/s²]

Selection rule: use the last valid sample with P timestamp <= Event timestamp; no interpolation. If START precedes the first full-P sample, use the INITIAL_STATE P0 diagonal.
